about: Hebrew grammar probe for plan W5.3: 200 sentences with one marked error each (rule = the error class), built from templates and word lists by scripts/grammar/make-probe.mjs, with the corrected sentence beside each one for the false-positive check. Development numbers, not a held-out result: the same author wrote the sentences and the rules. Real-text false positives are measured on the HeQ dev paragraphs (eval/golden/retrieval/dev/heq.json).
